description: MCP server exposing get_thread() -- the live Slack conversation a chat-triggered agent run is answering, fetched fresh every call from the channel/thread identifiers this run's own tags name.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Resource key the toolset is registered under.

slack_bot_token_env_var.label: Slack Bot Token Env Var
slack_bot_token_env_var.description: Env var holding the bot's 'xoxb-...' token. Needs channels:history (or groups:history).

channel_template.label: Channel Template
channel_template.description: Template string for this spawned server's SLACK_CHAT_TOOLS_CHANNEL env value -- the calling agent's own {tag.<key>} substitution resolves it at run time (see README). Set to a literal channel id instead if every run should always read the same fixed channel.

thread_ts_template.label: Thread Ts Template
thread_ts_template.description: Template string for this spawned server's SLACK_CHAT_TOOLS_THREAD_TS env value, same mechanism as channel_template.

max_result_chars.label: Max Result Chars
max_result_chars.description: Upper bound on the serialized size of any tool result.

mcp_server_resource_key.label: Mcp Server Resource Key
mcp_server_resource_key.description: If set, ALSO registers a stdio MCP-server-shaped resource (same name/type/command/env shape as MCPServerResource) under this key, built from this component's own settings. channel_template/thread_ts_template are passed through VERBATIM as env values -- resolved by the calling agent's own {tag.*} substitution at run time, not by this component. Any mcp_servers-aware component (the agent components, agentic_pipeline) can then reference it via server_resource_key instead of hand-writing an inline command+env entry. Leave unset to skip this -- existing resource_key-only behavior is unchanged.

receipts_db_path.label: Receipts Db Path
receipts_db_path.description: SQLite file path -- the SAME receipts_db_path a slack_reply instance (and the knowledge_search_server/hybrid_knowledge_search_server the agent calls) are configured with. When set, get_thread() attaches receipt_ids to any BOT-authored message in the thread (a prior reply from this same chat agent, looked up via slack_reply's own receipt-message link table) -- so the model can see which knowledge-base searches a past answer was built from, without parsing its own text for a 'ref: <id>' marker.

report_files_dir.label: Report Files Dir
report_files_dir.description: Local directory root -- the SAME files_dir a report_tools_server this agent calls is configured with. When set, ALSO registers an upload_files tool so the agent can post a generated chart/PDF/doc/spreadsheet (by file_id) into the thread mid-conversation, instead of waiting for slack_reply's own end-of-run delivery. Needs run_id_template too (left at its default) so this run's own files can be found.

run_id_template.label: Run Id Template
run_id_template.description: Template for the spawned server's SLACK_CHAT_TOOLS_RUN_ID env var -- left as the literal string '{run_id}' here; the CALLING agent's own generic {run_id}/{tag.*} substitution resolves it to the real run id before the subprocess is spawned (same mechanism as report_tools_server's own run_id_template). Only used by upload_files (report_files_dir).

enable_canvas_tool.label: Enable Canvas Tool
enable_canvas_tool.description: Also registers create_canvas(title, markdown): creates a Slack canvas (better than a PDF for a long document people will keep and edit), tabs it into this channel, and returns its link for the agent to include in its own answer. Needs canvases:write -- a NEW scope beyond what this component otherwise needs.
